ObjectStates.Name: Bag
ObjectStates.Nickname: SET_ITS18 Akial Interference — Azure Circuit — REVISED
ObjectStates.Description:
Akial Interference / Azure Circuit
48 × 48 inches; 300 points.
Terrain fitted to objective footprints and walking routes.

Official mission: https://experience.corvusbelli.com/en/game-content/11a4927a-4056-4515-8dc6-d9500ba61be5
Geometry revision: TTS engine and visual review still required.

Deployment: take this bag into the normal Infinity mod and drop it onto its map deployment spot.
